great.name: Modern/advanced treatments explicitly covered (list given; no sub-limits mentioned in extract)
great.quote: (d) Advance Technology Methods: ... The Company will indemnify the Insured Person for the Hospitalization Expenses incurred for treatment taken through following advance technology methods: A. Uterine Artery Embolization and HIFU ... G. Robotic surgeries ... H. Stereotactic radio surgeries ... L. Stem cell therapy: Hematopoietic stem cells for bone marrow transplant for haematological conditions to be covered

good.explanation: 30-day initial waiting is standard for health insurance (accidents covered immediately).

good.name: Pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period = 36 months

good.name: Specific illness (named ailment) waiting period = 24 months

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover = 30 days; Post-hospitalization cover = 60 days
good.quote: (i) As Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses during a period of 30 days immediately prior to the date of the Insured Person's admission to the Hospital; and (ii) As Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses during a period of 60 days immediately following the date of the Insured Person's discharge from Hospital,
good.reference: Section 3.2 Benefit 2: Pre-Hospitalization & Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses
good.explanation: 30-day pre and 60-day post are standard minimum ranges (good).

bad.name: No restore/recharge benefit mentioned (assumed not covered)
bad.quote: Any Claim paid except for Benefit 4 shall reduce the Sum Insured for the Policy Year and only the balance shall be available for all future Claims for that Policy Year.
bad.reference: Section 3 Scope of Cover (General Conditions) / Sum Insured reduction clause
bad.explanation: No restore benefit is stated; claims reduce the available Sum Insured for the year. This means coverage is not replenished after a claim (red flag vs many modern plans that restore SI).
